text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since you have no recent infections or family history, and the weakness is symmetrical, have you noticed any specific difficulty with tasks like buttoning shirts or holding objects in your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had trouble swallowing or slurred speech. I also have not noticed breathing difficulty, and the symptoms started gradually about a month ago.

speaker: Doctor

The gradual onset over a month with symmetrical weakness and diplopia on gaze is concerning; have you noticed any fatigue with chewing or closing your eyes tightly?
